heading.en: Birth, studies and exile in London

body.zh-Hant: 伊格納齊·莫希奇茨基1867年12月1日生於馬佐夫舍的米熱諾沃，是一月起義參加者之子。他1887至1891年就讀里加理工學校化學系，1890年起與社會主義的第二無產階級黨往來，並參與籌備刺殺總督的行動。1892年7月他因有被捕之虞，經東普魯士逃往倫敦，在倫敦與出版《Przedświt》的波蘭社會主義者同處一圈，並在此結識畢蘇斯基，日後兩人保持密切往來。
body.en: Ignacy Mościcki was born on 1 December 1867 in Mierzanów in Mazovia, the son of a January Uprising veteran. He studied chemistry at the Riga Polytechnic in 1887–1891 and from 1890 was linked to the socialist Second Proletariat, taking part in preparing an assassination of the governor-general. Threatened with arrest, in July 1892 he crossed illegally into East Prussia and went on to London, where he moved in the circle of Polish socialists publishing Przedświt and met Piłsudski, with whom he later kept close contacts.

heading.zh-Hant: 電化學與氮肥工業、教職
heading.en: Electrochemistry, the nitrogen industry and professorships

body.zh-Hant: 1897年莫希奇茨基受僱為瑞士弗里堡大學教授的助理；1904年他發明並取得高壓電容器專利，另研製可生產硝酸的旋焰爐。1913年起他在利沃夫理工學校主持電工技術與工業化學講座。1922年波蘭自德國手中接收霍茹夫的氮肥廠時，他被派去恢復生產，並從1922年中起主持該廠至1926年。1925年6月他出任利沃夫理工學院院長，同年10月改任華沙理工學院電化學講座。
body.en: In 1897 Mościcki was hired as an assistant at the University of Fribourg in Switzerland. In 1904 he created and patented high-voltage capacitors, and he also built a furnace with a rotating flame for producing nitric acid. From 1913 he headed the chair of technical electrotechnics and industrial chemistry at the Lwów Polytechnic. When Poland took over the Chorzów nitrogen works from Germany in 1922 he was sent to restore production, and he directed them from mid-1922 until 1926. In June 1925 he became rector of the Lwów Polytechnic, and from October the same year he took the chair of technical electrochemistry at the Warsaw Polytechnic.

body.zh-Hant: 1926年6月1日國民議會選舉莫希奇茨基為總統，他與畢蘇斯基的關係密切；IPN人物小傳說，當時國家權力實際掌握在畢蘇斯基手中，他的角色偏向禮儀性。1933年5月他再度當選，畢蘇斯基死後他領導所謂「城堡派」。1939年9月17日他越境進入羅馬尼亞，9月30日辭去總統職務。
body.en: The National Assembly elected Mościcki president on 1 June 1926, and he was close to Piłsudski; the IPN biogram says that while Piłsudski held real state power, Mościcki's role was largely representative. He was re-elected in May 1933, and after Piłsudski's death he headed the so-called Castle group. On 17 September 1939 he crossed into Romania, and on 30 September he resigned the presidency.

heading.en: Exile in Switzerland, death and reburial

body.zh-Hant: 莫希奇茨基獲釋後，自1939年12月起住在瑞士；瑞士《歷史辭典》另記，他以瑞士公民身分得聯邦委員會准許居留，條件是不從事政治活動。他1946年10月2日在日內瓦近郊的韋爾索瓦去世，遺體於1993年9月13日改葬華沙主教座堂地下墓室。
body.en: After his release Mościcki lived in Switzerland from December 1939; the Historical Lexicon of Switzerland adds that, as a Swiss citizen, he was allowed by the Federal Council to live there on condition that he abstain from political activity. He died on 2 October 1946 in Versoix near Geneva, and his remains were laid in the crypt of Warsaw's cathedral on 13 September 1993.

heading.zh-Hant: 出身、科英布拉與1921年議員
heading.en: Origins, Coimbra and the 1921 deputy seat

body.zh-Hant: 薩拉查1889年4月28日生於葡萄牙的維米耶羅（聖孔巴當）。他進過神學院但放棄教士之路，轉入科英布拉大學讀法律，並領導當地最知名的天主教學生組織；他與日後的里斯本宗主教塞雷茹拉的友誼也始於這段時期。他走學術路線擔任經濟法教授，Lex寫他1918至1928年任科英布拉大學教授。他是天主教中央黨領導人之一，並以該黨名義在1921年選舉當選議員，同年7月議會提前解散後離開議席。
body.en: António de Oliveira Salazar was born on 28 April 1889 in Vimieiro (Santa Comba Dão), Portugal. He attended a seminary but abandoned the ecclesiastical path to study law at the University of Coimbra, where he led the best-known Catholic student organization; his friendship with the future cardinal patriarch of Lisbon, Manuel Cerejeira, dates from this period. He pursued a university career as a professor of economic law, and Lex records him as a Coimbra professor from 1918 to 1928. He was one of the leaders of the Catholic Center Party and was elected as a deputy for it in 1921, leaving the seat after the early dissolution of parliament in July 1921.

body.zh-Hant: Costa Pinto寫道，軍事政變後有人邀請薩拉查入閣，他因政局不穩而婉拒；兩年後再被邀請時他接受，條件是對其他部會握有重要權力，以解決獨裁政權的預算危機。Lex則寫他在1928年取得所需權限後才接掌財政部，並進一步兼領外交、戰爭與殖民部。兩份來源對1926年那次邀請的說法不同，見缺漏。Costa Pinto另寫，1928至1932年間他在天主教會與部分軍方支持下掌控了這個軍事獨裁。
body.en: Costa Pinto writes that after the military coup Salazar declined an invitation to join the cabinet because the political situation was unstable; asked again two years later, he accepted on condition that he receive important powers over the other ministries to resolve the dictatorship's budgetary crisis. Lex says he took the finance post only once he had obtained the powers he needed in 1928, and later also took on the foreign, war and colonial ministries. The two sources differ on the 1926 invitation (see gaps). Costa Pinto adds that between 1928 and 1932 he came to dominate the military dictatorship with support from the Church and parts of the armed forces.

heading.en: Prime minister and the Estado Novo

body.zh-Hant: GND權威檔記他1932至1968年任葡萄牙總理，Lex也寫1932年他兼任總理，1933年建立威權的新國家體制。Costa Pinto說，在1933年經公民投票通過的新憲法下，他由上而下建立單一政黨；同時總統卡爾莫納仍有權罷免包括薩拉查在內的任何官員。西班牙內戰於1936年爆發後，新國家體制趨於激進；1939年葡萄牙宣布中立，使這個獨裁政權得以度過二戰。
body.en: The GND authority record gives him as prime minister of Portugal in 1932–1968, and Lex says he also became prime minister in 1932 and that the authoritarian Estado Novo was introduced in 1933. Costa Pinto writes that under the new constitution approved in a plebiscite in 1933 he created a single party from above, while President Carmona retained the authority to dismiss any appointed official, Salazar included. The New State became radicalized after the Spanish Civil War broke out in 1936, and Portugal's declaration of neutrality in 1939 let the dictatorship survive the Second World War.

body.en: Costa Pinto writes that in 1968, after a cardiovascular attack, Salazar was removed from power; Lex says he fell ill and was succeeded by Marcelo Caetano in 1968. The GND authority record gives his death as 27 July 1970.

body.zh-Hant: 斐迪南1865年8月24日生於西格馬林根，父親是霍亨索倫-西格馬林根侯爵利奧波德一世。他在杜塞道夫的中學畢業後，加入第一近衛步兵團，隨後在圖賓根與萊比錫讀了三個學期的法學、國民經濟與歷史。1889年，他以年已六十歲、沒有子嗣的叔父卡爾之繼承人身分遷居羅馬尼亞。
body.en: Ferdinand was born on 24 August 1865 in Sigmaringen, the son of Prince Leopold I of Hohenzollern-Sigmaringen. After finishing school at the Düsseldorf Gymnasium he entered the 1st Foot Guards and then studied law, economics and history for three semesters in Tübingen and Leipzig. In 1889 he moved to Romania as heir of his then sixty-year-old, childless uncle Karl.

body.zh-Hant: NDB記載，卡爾親自引導他認識政務，並為他說合與英國公主瑪麗的婚事；兩人1893年在西格馬林根結婚。第二次巴爾幹戰爭中，這位王儲率軍推進到索非亞城下。他在叔父於1914年10月10日去世後繼位。
body.en: The NDB records that Karl personally initiated him into the business of government and arranged his marriage to the English princess Marie; the couple married in Sigmaringen in 1893. In the Second Balkan War the heir led the army as far as Sofia. After his uncle's death on 10 October 1914, he ascended the throne.

body.zh-Hant: NDB寫道，他徒勞地抵制宮廷與多數民意要求加入協約國一方參戰的情緒，但在國家下決心參戰後堅持到底。Lex記載羅馬尼亞於1916年8月參戰，起初近乎全國被德軍占領，但戰爭結束時各省在1918年底合併為大羅馬尼亞。1922年10月15日他在阿爾巴尤利亞被加冕為「全體羅馬尼亞人之王」。
body.en: The NDB says he resisted in vain the mood, at court and among most of the people, that pressed for entering the war on the Allied side, but held to the decision once it was taken. Lex records that Romania entered the war in August 1916 and was at first almost entirely overrun by the German army, but that at the end of 1918 the provinces were joined into Greater Romania. On 15 October 1922 he was crowned at Alba Iulia as king of all Romanians.

body.zh-Hant: Lex寫道，他的統治期間推行了廣泛的土地改革，且羅馬尼亞在1923年有了新憲法。NDB記載，兒子卡羅在1925年放棄王位繼承權，使他晚年蒙上陰影；他1927年7月20日在布加勒斯特去世。
body.en: Lex writes that his reign saw an extensive land reform and that Romania received a new constitution in 1923. The NDB records that his son Carol's renunciation of the succession in 1925 darkened his last years; he died in Bucharest on 20 July 1927.
